title: I. Crimson
objective: Come to your senses in a room that is not yours, and work out what it is telling you.
recap: The small hours of the twenty-eighth of June, 1349. A desk you had never seen, a body that was already sitting up, a revolver by your right hand and four words on the page in front of you in handwriting that would shortly be yours. Everyone will die, including me.

title: II. The Situation
objective: Decide what sort of man you are going to be about it, and let your brother in.
recap: Benson took the revolver off the table before the constable came up the stairs, and Melissa stood on the landing doing sums about a funeral that was not going to be needed. Eight days later a tired man from Zouteland Street put two contracts on the table and asked how you meant to carry it.

title: III. The Seventh Unit
objective: Report to No. 36 Zouteland Street and take the notebook file off the board.
recap: Blackthorn Security Company on the brass plate, Seventh Unit of the Special Operations Department on the warrant card, and the Church of the Evernight Goddess behind both. Dunn Smith gave the notebook file to the civilian staffer whose own name was already in it.

title: IV. Potion
objective: Drink what the Church signed for, in the cellar room with the drain in the floor.
recap: Grey, and thicker than it looked. Seer, Sequence 9: divination, misdirection, and a face nobody remembers. A role, said Smith, not a tool — you act it, or in time it acts you.

title: V. The Club
objective: Chalk the circle on your own floor and go looking for a way home.
recap: No way home: grey fog to every horizon, a ruined palace above it, and a bronze table with twenty-two seats. You were at the head of it before you had decided to sit down. Two of the chairs filled, and neither occupant doubted for a moment that they were addressing a god.

title: VI. The Rooms Above The Shop
objective: See Welch McGovern for yourself, and establish that nobody came in or went out.
recap: Bolted, shuttered and nailed from the inside, with eleven pounds untouched a yard from the body. Nobody killed Welch McGovern. He read something aloud that was written to be read aloud, and the book did not care which man was holding it.

title: VII. The Parcel
objective: Work out where the notebook went — and who carried it there.
recap: A postal receipt in his coat pocket, book rate, paid in coin at half past five in the morning, in your own handwriting. Mr. Franky heard your door. You have no memory of any of it.

title: VIII. Ray Bieber
objective: Find out who has been alone with it for six days.
recap: Number nine, Cobble Yard: a warehouse clerk who signed for a parcel, sent word he was ill, and has not been heard to move about since. His landlady has stopped knocking.

title: IX. The Warehouse
objective: Go into Cobble Yard behind the Nighthawks, and come out with the notebook.
recap: Ray Bieber had read it all the way to the end, and it had made the book his core. Daly Simone took him apart along seams a body should not have — and then a man in white paint, sitting on the crates with his ankles crossed, offered to sell you the name of the rung above your own.

title: X. Clown
objective: Close the file, digest the Seer potion, and take Sequence 8 at the circle.
recap: Clown. Sequence 8 of the Seer pathway, bought with a word out of a dead man's mouth and drunk in the cellar room under Zouteland Street.

title: XI. The Rest Of The Ladder
objective: Work, keep the quarter paid, and stay the sort of man who can explain every step of it.
